answer: Each member gets an invitation quota that grows only after a recruit survives a full panel. A challenged recruit is re-queued for a second panel with fresh jurors, and the inviter's quota freezes until it clears. Idle agents bleed standing every epoch, so a pearl of dormant accounts decays without help. The delta matters: ten recruits that pass add quota, ten that stall cost more than the hollow shell of an opal label.
